definitions.explanation: Manual labor involved in farming, such as planting, harvesting, weeding, and tending crops. Refers to the physical tasks of agriculture rather than farm management.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}から{農作業|のうさぎょう}をする。
examples.english: I do farm work from the morning.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{毎日|まいにち}{農作業|のうさぎょう}に{汗|あせ}を{流|なが}している。
examples.english: My grandfather works up a sweat doing farm work every day.

examples.japanese: {機械化|きかいか}が{進|すす}んで{農作業|のうさぎょう}の{負担|ふたん}が{大|おお}きく{減|へ}った。
examples.english: Mechanization has advanced and the burden of farm work has decreased significantly.

notes:
{農作業|のうさぎょう} refers to the hands-on physical tasks of farming — planting, weeding, harvesting, and tending crops.

FORMS:
{農|のう} (agriculture) + {作業|さぎょう} (work, labor)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農作業|のうさぎょう}をする: to do farm work
- {農作業|のうさぎょう}に{従事|じゅうじ}する: to engage in farm work (formal)
- {農作業|のうさぎょう}を{手伝|てつだ}う: to help with farm work
- {農作業|のうさぎょう}の{合間|あいま}に: between farm tasks
- {農作業|のうさぎょう}の{負担|ふたん}: the burden of farm work

RELATED WORDS:
- {農業|のうぎょう}: agriculture, farming (the industry/occupation)
- {農家|のうか}: farmer, farm household
- {田植|たう}え: rice planting
- {収穫|しゅうかく}: harvesting

SIMILAR WORDS:
{農作業|のうさぎょう} emphasizes the physical labor aspect of farming, while {農業|のうぎょう} refers to farming as an industry or profession.
